stories.head: Japan Heads for Phobos
stories.blurb: Japan's MMX probe is on its way to Phobos, a moon of Mars. It will drop a rover with a drill, scoop up some of the surface and bring it home, landing in the South Australian outback.

stories.head: Waterlily Found on Instagram
stories.blurb: A giant waterlily first noticed in someone's Instagram photos is a new species, Victoria colombiana. A short expedition finally found it in two jungle lakes. It is already at risk.

stories.head: Elk Get a Bridge
stories.blurb: A grass-covered bridge over Interstate 25 opened last December so elk, bears and pronghorns can cross safely. Crashes with wildlife have plunged since.

cards.means: when MMX's capsule lands back on Earth
plants the team found across two lakes
the drop in crashes with wildlife
